site.name: Adrian Shaft
site.componentDetail: Named historic shaft/mine locality shown on Keystone-area mapping
overview: Adrian Shaft is a named historic mine-shaft locality in Summit County near the Montezuma and Keystone mining areas. The mapped feature is at approximately 39.59943, -105.88085.
Remnant uses the mapped locality for identification only. The record does not assert the present condition, accessibility, or safety of the shaft collar or underground workings.

sourceReferences.note: Corroborates the named Summit County mine locality, coordinates, and elevation.
